title: Topstitch Magic: Designing a Coach Chain in Clo3D
content:
Here’s how I created the **detailed Coach chain** for the bag I submitted to the competition. ✨  
I used the **Topstitch** feature, and **every step was modelled in Clo3D** , ensuring the final piece is as precise and realistic as possible.
